# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image and text reliability**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.158.0 update improves filtered image and glyph correctness without changing managed APIs. Skia m158 fixes keep antialiased sampling inside image subsets and make image-filter cache equality consistent with hashing.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Constrain antialiased texture sampling** — Image filters and Ganesh draws retain subset clamping when padding cannot contain AA or MSAA extrapolation. Minified, strongly skewed and transparent-border draws avoid sampling unrelated pixels outside logical texture bounds. ([#5768](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5768))
- **Keep image-filter cache keys consistent** — Cache-key equality now follows the same bytewise representation as hashing, accounting for signed zero, matrix type metadata and subnormal values so lookups and LRU eviction agree. ([#5768](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5768))
- **Respect regenerated glyph formats and layout** — Mask-filtered text handles font-scaler reloads whose paths, formats or bounds change. It avoids stale-path rasterization, sub-byte buffer overwrites and format assertions, clears incompatible masks, and correctly copies clipped embossed-mask planes. ([#5739](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5739))
